name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.setting.ChannelSettingActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from a channel's settings entry. It lets users edit the channel name or topic, manage channel permissions and member allow/block lists, or delete the channel.
disableEffect: Users cannot use the built-in QChat screen to configure or delete the channel.
